content:
Six days ago, Apple released the iOS 27.2 developer beta 1, skipping iOS 27.1 beta. After releasing developer beta 2 yesterday, Apple has now launched the first iOS 27.2 public beta, which includes a brand-new iPhone Health app. Apple has also opened up the ability to book and purchase lab services through Quest Diagnostics via the new Health app.

iOS 27.2 beta includes a new Health app and more

iOS 27.2 will be the next release following the official launch of iOS 27 on September 14. iOS 27.1 is only available for iPhone Duo.

Apple has detailed how the iOS 27.1 SDK will let developers take full advantage of the iPhone Duo's display. You can see here how apps appear on the iPhone Duo depending on the targeted iOS version.

Apple released Xcode 27.1 beta on Friday, adding an iPhone Duo simulator and app development support for the new foldable iPhone.

The first iOS 27.2 developer beta includes the following updates:

  • The redesigned Health app first unveiled at the iPhone 18 Pro event officially debuts in this beta.
  • Dual Capture mode joins Group FaceTime.
  • Siri AI language support adds French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish.
  • Apple TV app profile features land on iPhone.
  • Apple Podcasts' 'Up Next' has been renamed to 'New Episodes.' The 'Continue Playing' section now appears directly below 'New Episodes.' The podcast episode list also features color-matched backgrounds.
  • Apple Music now uses fewer icon colors to mark labels.

iOS 27.2 is expected to officially release in October. iPhone users can currently try out the new Apple Health app early through the developer beta or public beta channels.
